title: PunnkFunnk BeatXtra Wireless Stereo Bluetooth Headphones V5.3, Over Ear Foldable Headset with 40mm Drivers, Soft Cushioned Ear Pads, Built-in Mic, AUX Input, 10M Wireless Range, Teen & Adults (Beige)
bullets: Advanced Bluetooth 5.3 Technology: Enjoy faster pairing, stable connectivity, and low power consumption with Bluetooth V5.3. Connect seamlessly to smartphones, laptops, tablets, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices with a reliable wireless range of up to 10 meters.

Immersive HD Stereo Sound: Equipped with powerful 40mm dynamic drivers that deliver rich bass, balanced mids, and crystal-clear highs. Perfect for music, movies, gaming, online classes, and voice calls with impressive sound quality.

Comfortable Over-Ear Design: Soft cushioned ear cups and an adjustable headband provide a secure and comfortable fit for extended listening sessions. Lightweight construction makes them ideal for travel, office work, and daily use.

Wireless & Wired Playback: Supports Bluetooth wireless mode and 3.5mm AUX wired connection, allowing uninterrupted entertainment even when the battery is low. Compatible with mobile phones, laptops, PCs, tablets, and more.

Long Battery Performance: Provides up to 4.5 hours of music playback, 3 hours of talk time, up to 250 hours of standby, and recharges within 2–3 hours. Built-in microphone ensures clear hands-free calling and online meetings.
